captions_note: the voice runs on under the freeze, so the reel's captions stay on. The chips go on clear background first: if work/layout.jpg shows a chip in the caption band, use fewer or shorter labels or hide the reel captions for the slot (--hide-captions a-b)
in_a_reel: LOOK at work/freeze_pick.jpg before rendering, every time: eyes open, sharp, a good expression. HOLD = 'auto' can pick a blink; change HOLD until the held frame is right
start the slot before the freeze word (frame 0 is live picture) and leave 13 frames or more of live picture after RELEASE. RELEASE = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
label text is the buyer's own words for what they say in the clip: no number, result or claim they do not say
steps: run bake_freeze.py      # print the words with their start frames and check the cutout is finished
edit fill the CLIP block in build.py, then build (about 12 s); a line starting with !! is a stop or a warning to act on
run check.py      # numbers, sheet, stills, phone copy
